No legible writing of any kind: no annotations, labels, captions, dates or signature. No border or frame. Nothing anachronistic for the year given. Landscape aspect ratio 3:2.

Recognizable real proportions roughly 55 metres wide and 30 metres total height, not absurdly tall. Weathered pale grey limestone, low Yucatan forest flat horizon, foreground limestone outcrops and sparse dry grass. Main pyramid occupies middle third to half of width with space and sky around it. No invented extra temples, no mountains, no crowds or tourist ropes, no neon colors, no readable text.
A single coherent perspective, correct architecture and scale. Delicate visible graphite, quick sepia hatching and sparse watercolour, irregular unfinished edges fading into bare cream paper. No frame or annotations.
